about: Recorded OK-WW screens for the gamesim harness (design section 1, Frame library). Paths are relative to this folder; sha256 is of the committed file. The repository is public: every frame has OK-WW's UID strip (config.blur_area) blacked out. Frames are added with relay/tests/gamesim/tools/add_frame.py. Each truth item is text a person read on the frame, at `box` (relative x0, y0, x1, y1), inside one of `regions` - the boxes our overlay (or the upstream line it follows) OCRs; okww/test_frame_truth.py runs the real OCR in that region on Windows and requires the text there. `unrecorded` lists the screens the scenarios need that have no frame yet.
